name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Riyadh missile attack 8 Nov; US–Iran war
summary: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted two Houthi missiles at Riyadh on 8 Nov; shrapnel damaged an Aramco building
state: Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said shrapnel from an attempted attack damaged an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh on 8 Nov, with no injuries, and the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi missiles (The Week; CNN). The Houthis claimed six operations against Saudi oil sites, Riyadh airport and troops on 7 Nov (WION). The Houthi-run health ministry said Saudi strikes near Sanaa on 7 Nov killed at least 33 people, a figure not independently confirmed.
for_you: People in or travelling to the region can check FCDO travel advice. Attacks on Saudi oil sites add to the exposure of energy markets already affected by the Gulf conflict.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation: Houthi–Saudi cross-border strikes 7–8 Nov alongside the US–Iran war
